title: Expose a typed queue-pause cause in the session API so UI cards stop matching backend preview strings
outcome: The session API carries a typed cause for a paused queue (for example: user stop, Engram admission retrying automatically with attempt and next time, Engram hold needing Resume or Cancel, provider or turn failure, source observation), and the paused-queue and retained-prompt cards read it instead of matching session.preview strings.
acceptance: Expose a typed queue-pause cause in the session API so UI cards stop matching backend preview strings is done
